newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore HSFO seen hovering around $120-$124/t.
newsitem.headline: Singapore HSFO seen hovering around $120-$124/t.

text.p: High sulphur fuel oil prices on Thursday were expected to hover between $120-$124 for end October loading, traders said.
Fuel oil 180 centistoke prices on Wednesday were quoted between $123-$124 per tonne.
Most traders said market fundamentals remained soft. They said there remained sufficient supplies to meet demand.
A major said if the two buyers who were bidding in the spot market on Wednesday emerge to buy again, prices would be supported.
At least two firm offers were expected to emerge in the spot market later Thursday, traders said.
Prices reached a five-year high on late Wednesday when a local trader purchased a 20,000 tonne 180-cst cargo at $124 per tonne for end October loading.
Traders said prices are unlikely to breach $124 per tonne later Thursday as crude prices have fallen.
October paper swaps were quoted lower at $121-$122 on crude losses, down from Wednesday's $121.50-$122.50
